part.text:
End-to-end smoke test confirms incremental builds, skip detection, and manifest caching all work correctly against the compiled CLI. Full Jest suite (63 tests, including 15 new incremental-build tests) and `tsc --noEmit` both pass cleanly.

Summary of changes:
- `src/hash.ts` — sha256 content hashing helper.
- `src/cache.ts` — `.ssg-cache.json` manifest load/save (missing/corrupt → empty manifest), plus template/partials hashing for invalidation.
- `src/frontmatter.ts` — added `parseFrontmatterCached` (hash-keyed memoization) for the "cache parsed frontmatter" requirement.
- `src/engine.ts` — extracted `resolveTemplateName`, wired frontmatter caching into `makeDraft`, split `runBuild` into reusable `runBeforeBuild`/`runAfterBuild`.
- `src/build.ts` — new `buildIncremental()`: per-page skip when source hash + resolved-template hash are unchanged *and* the output file still exists on disk; falls back to a full rebuild on `--clean`, missing cache, or corrupt cache; reports `{ total, built, skipped, timeMs, timeSavedMs }`.
- `src/cli.ts` — `ssg build --incremental` / `--clean` flags with stats printed to stdout.
- `src/index.ts`, `.gitignore` — export new modules, ignore `.ssg-cache.json`.
- `tests/incremental.test.ts` (new) + additions to `tests/cli.test.ts` covering: first/second run skip behavior, source-change/new-page/removed-page detection, per-layout and shared-partial invalidation, deleted-output recovery, `--clean`, missing/corrupt cache fallback, stale entry pruning, time-saved reporting, and full plugin-pipeline (index page) correctness across skip/rebuild mixes.

Plugin architecture is untouched — skipped pages simply bypass `onFile`/`buildFile`, while `beforeBuild`/`afterBuild` still run every pass so things like the generated index page stay complete.
